keyFindings.text: Every FigJam write is classed MUTATING and therefore needs confirmation plus an explicit target plus a one-line rollback before it runs; destructive `fj delete` and arbitrary `fj eval` are omitted from the normal path entirely. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/mcp-tooling/mcp-figma/references/tool-surface.md:51] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/mcp-tooling/mcp-figma/references/tool-surface.md:184]

FigJam authoring exists only in the CLI surface, as the `fj` command group: `fj list|info|nodes` is read-only, `fj sticky|shape|text|connect|move|update` is mutating, `fj delete <nodeId> [-p]` is destructive, and `fj eval <code> [-p]` is arbitrary execution. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/mcp-tooling/mcp-figma/references/tool-surface.md:149] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/mcp-tooling/mcp-figma/references/figma-cli-reference.md:348]

FigJam writes cannot run headless: the CLI drives the live Figma Desktop app over a local daemon on `127.0.0.1:3456`, needs the app open with a file, needs Node 18+, and treats macOS as the supported baseline with Linux and Windows experimental. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/mcp-tooling/mcp-figma/README.md:26] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/mcp-tooling/mcp-figma/README.md:99]

The documented command surface drifts from the source, so a FigJam verb and its flags must be verified with `<bin> <command> --help` before being written into a Product Owner procedure; the skill records documented-but-unregistered commands and primitive-name drift as confirmed gaps. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/mcp-tooling/mcp-figma/references/tool-surface.md:17] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/mcp-tooling/mcp-figma/references/figma-cli-reference.md:372]

The Figma MCP direction available in this repo is read-only design context: the registered `figma` manual is the third-party Framelink `figma-developer-mcp` over stdio, which wraps the Figma REST API and "does not drive Figma Desktop", so it cannot create or edit FigJam nodes. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/mcp-tooling/mcp-figma/references/mcp-wiring.md:35] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/mcp-tooling/mcp-figma/references/mcp-wiring.md:68]

The skill's premise is CLI-primary with an optional MCP: `figma-ds-cli` is the canonical binary, and a full read of the CLI repo found no MCP server inside it; an "MCP for Figma" is always a separate external server. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/mcp-tooling/mcp-figma/references/figma-cli-reference.md:360]

No input type supplies a complete edge. The minimum representation therefore is: nodes carrying an id, a kind from a small vocabulary (start, end, step, decision, state, note), a label and a platform/source pointer; edges carrying a source, a target and an optional condition label; plus layout order and grouping hints, because move and update exist but no automatic layout verb does. [INFERENCE: derived from the verb inventory at tool-surface.md:150 and the input evidence in iteration 2-4]

The six write verbs set the ceiling on what the model may contain: sticky, shape and text create nodes, connect creates an edge between nodes, and move and update position or relabel them.
